source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Note the date and time of the failed audit.
3. Identify the authorized person(s) who conducted the audit.
4. List the specific industrial safety standards/regulations that were not met.
5. Describe any observed violations in detail (use photos, videos, or sketches if necessary).
6. Note the potential risks to employee safety and health related to each violation.
7. Record any comments made by auditors about the seriousness of the deficiencies.
8. Add findings from interviews with employees or management about safety procedures and practices.
9. Compile documentation from all areas evaluated, such as safety training records, maintenance logs, emergency response plans, hazardous material inventories, etc.
10. Include recommendations and corrective action plans provided by the auditors.
11. Document any management responses to the audit report.
12. Keep records of follow-up actions, including deadlines for corrective measures.
13. Recap the audit findings and key issues in a summary section.
14. Organize
